about.title: About Perkūnas Racing Team
about.description: We are a student-led Formula Student team at Vilnius Gediminas Technical University, dedicated to designing, building, and racing electric formula cars. Our mission is to provide hands-on engineering experience while competing at the international level.
about.missionText: To inspire the next generation of engineers through practical experience in automotive engineering and competitive racing.
about.visionText: To become a leading Formula Student team, recognized for innovation, technical excellence, and sustainability.
about.noPostsYet: No posts yet. Check back soon for updates!
about.heroSubtitle: Lithuanian student team building the future on racing tracks
about.whoWeAreDesc1: Perkūnas Racing Team is a student team from Lithuania that designs and builds a racing car for Formula Student competitions. Our goal is not only to achieve high results on the track, but also to develop engineering, managerial and creative skills.
about.whoWeAreDesc2: The team brings together students from various fields: from mechanics, electronics, to design and business. Each member contributes to the common goal – to create an innovative, fast and reliable racing car.
about.missionDesc1: We develop future leaders in engineering, technology and business by creating an environment where theoretical knowledge becomes real solutions. As a united team, we not only create a car, but also form a sustainable learning climate.
about.missionDesc2: We are committed to promoting growth, building strong partnerships with industry professionals, and pushing the boundaries of student motorsport, contributing to innovation both in Lithuania and internationally.
about.formulaStudentDesc1: Formula Student is one of the most prestigious engineering competitions in the world, bringing together university engineering students from around the world to showcase their skills in design, manufacturing, testing and project management.
about.formulaStudentDesc2: In competitions, teams are evaluated not only on the track, but also when presenting a business plan, marketing strategies, production capabilities and cost analysis. Success depends on creativity, technical knowledge, innovation and teamwork.

about.valueLearningDesc: Every project is an opportunity to grow and improve

partners.title: Our Partners
partners.subtitle: Together we build the future - thank you to our partners for the support that allows us to pursue our dreams and push technology forward.
partners.description: We are grateful for the support of our sponsors and partners who make our work possible.
partners.contactUs: Contact us to learn about partnership opportunities
partners.sponsorDesc1: Sponsor support provides a top-level opportunity to become part of a dynamic Formula Student project. Your brand will gain high visibility on our racing car, team apparel, advertisements, events and competition appearances.
partners.sponsorDesc2: Sponsors have a unique opportunity to influence our technical, strategic and operational development, establishing direct connections with future engineers and innovators. This partnership provides direct connection with education and helps shape future talents.
partners.sponsorDesc3: We aim to create long-term relationships spanning multiple seasons, ensuring continuous mutual benefit. Your support also provides priority access to talented engineering students suitable for future employment and internship opportunities.
partners.sponsorDesc4: By joining from the very beginning, you become part of our entire journey – from idea to competition. You help create not just a racing car, but a culture of innovation and excellence.

iremas.name: Iremas
iremas.desc: One of the leading industrial maintenance and engineering solutions companies in Lithuania, providing high-quality services to the energy, industry, and infrastructure sectors. The company specializes in mechanical equipment installation, electrical engineering, automation, and industrial equipment maintenance. With over four decades of experience, Iremas successfully executes both local and international projects, ensuring safety, reliability, and high work quality.

ansys.name: Ansys
ansys.desc: A global leader in engineering simulation software, offering advanced solutions for product development, testing, and optimization. The company's software enables modeling of fluid dynamics, structures, electromagnetism, heat, and multi-physics processes. Ansys solutions are used across various industries – from automotive and aerospace to energy and healthcare.

rapidharness.name: RapidHarness
rapidharness.desc: Advanced wire harness design software created to automate and simplify the entire electrical system design process – from initial schematic to production-ready documentation. This CAD platform enables creating professional schematics in real-time, automatically generating documentation, and efficiently collaborating in teams or with external partners. RapidHarness solutions are used by engineers in various industries – from automotive and aerospace to electronics and manufacturing.

solidworks.name: SolidWorks
solidworks.desc: A global leader in 3D design and engineering solutions, creating advanced software for product development, engineering, and manufacturing. The company specializes in computer-aided design (CAD), analysis (CAE), and product data management (PDM) systems, helping companies create innovative, efficient, and sustainable solutions. SolidWorks solutions are used in various sectors – from automotive and aerospace to medical devices, electronics, and educational institutions worldwide.

join.title: Join the Team
join.description: Are you enthusiastic and interested in engineering and racing innovations? We're always looking for motivated students to join our team.
join.benefitsTitle: What will you gain by joining?
join.benefit1: You will gain practical experience in building, designing and testing a high-quality racing car.
join.benefit2: Working with sponsors and representing the team, you will learn the basics of business, marketing and project management.
join.benefit3: You will improve teamwork, leadership and time management skills in a collaborative environment.
join.benefit4: You will establish connections with university lecturers and industry partners, expanding your professional network.
join.benefit5: You will gain valuable knowledge and skills that will help you prepare for future engineering and business challenges.

engineering.title: Engineering Thinking
engineering.desc: We apply the most advanced engineering principles in designing, manufacturing and testing a real race car. Students gain practical experience by applying theoretical knowledge to real engineering challenges and building a solid foundation for their careers.

business.title: Business Skills
business.desc: Entrepreneurial abilities are developed through sponsor search, budget planning and project management. We learn to build partnerships, manage finances responsibly and work according to professional standards.

teamwork.title: United Team Environment
teamwork.desc: We create a supportive, inclusive and collaborative environment where each member contributes to collective success. Senior members pass on experience to juniors, ensuring sustainable team growth and consistent knowledge transfer.

professional.title: Professional Connections
professional.desc: We collaborate with leading engineering companies and industry leaders, building strong professional connections and knowledge exchange networks.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Exchange
knowledge.desc: We receive valuable consultations from industry experts, learning to apply best practices and improve our projects.

mentorship.title: Mentorship
mentorship.desc: We are helped by experienced engineers and specialists who provide individual mentorship and shape our career paths.

international.title: International Impact
international.desc: We participate in Formula Student competitions where we represent Lithuania and compete with the best universities in the world. We share our experience, creativity and innovations with the international community.

futureTech.title: Future Technologies
futureTech.desc: We explore electrification, autonomous systems and sustainable engineering principles, aiming to create more advanced and sustainable motorsport.
